title: Nether Fungus Drops
description: Makes wart blocks behave more similarly to mushroom blocks.
body:
## What Does This Do?
This datapack changes the drops of Nether Wart Blocks and Warped Wart Blocks. Instead of dropping itself as an item, the blocks have a chance to drop their respective Fungus when broken without a Silk Touch-enchanted tool. This is the same system that Red and Brown Mushroom Blocks use.
## How Does It Work?
This datapack changes the loot table files of both Wart Block types to use the same calculations the Red Mushroom Block uses.
## But Why?
This datapack makes it easier to farm Crimson and Warped Stems by returning their sapling equivalents the same way trees do, eliminating the need to transport and/or bonemeal Hyphae blocks in order to obtain more fungi.
## Credits
This datapack was inspired by a similar change made in the [Raspberry Flavoured](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/raspberry-flavoured) modpack.
